notes.subject: fix(mcp): read tool lists with boolean property schemas and stop retry loops
notes.summary: MCP servers whose tool lists use boolean property schemas now load, with non-standard tools repaired or skipped individually, and unreadable responses no longer trigger endless automatic retries.
